skills.title: Review a change
skills.summary: Catch correctness and maintainability issues before you commit.
skills.whenToUse: You have a staged change and want another pass before committing, while the context is still fresh.
prerequisites: A git repository with staged changes
outputs: Prioritized findings with file and line references
skills.examplePrompt: /review Review my staged changes for correctness and maintainability.
verify: Each finding points at a real line in the diff
You can explain why each fix you apply is needed

skills.title: Security review
skills.summary: Inspect staged changes for secrets, injection and unsafe defaults.
skills.whenToUse: Before committing a change that touches input handling, auth, configuration or dependencies.
prerequisites: A git repository with staged changes
skills.examplePrompt: /security-review Check my staged changes for security issues.
verify: No secrets remain in the staged diff
Each finding is resolved or consciously accepted

skills.title: Write the commit message
skills.summary: Turn a staged diff into a clear conventional commit message.
skills.whenToUse: Your change is reviewed, fixed and restaged, and you want a message that explains why.
outputs: A conventional commit message (it does not create the commit)
verify: The message describes the final diff, not an earlier draft

skills.title: Grill an idea
skills.summary: Stress-test an idea with pointed questions before you build it.
skills.whenToUse: You have a plan or design and want its gaps found before any code is written.
inputs: A short description of the idea or plan
skills.examplePrompt: /grill-me I want to publish my skills as a catalog on my blog.
verify: Every open question has an owner or a decision

skills.title: Search your notes
skills.summary: Find the evidence in your notes and reading highlights.
skills.whenToUse: You are about to write something and want to start from what you already read and noted.
prerequisites: A configured notes vault or Readwise account
outputs: Cited findings from your notes and highlights
skills.examplePrompt: /search-notes What have I saved about software supply chain attacks?
verify: Each finding links back to a note or highlight you can open

skills.title: Unslop a draft
skills.summary: Edit a draft while keeping its facts, structure and voice.
skills.whenToUse: A draft reads as generic or padded and you want it tightened without losing facts or citations.
skills.examplePrompt: /unslop Tighten this draft without changing any facts.
verify: Facts, numbers and citations match the original draft

workflows.title: Review a change, then commit it
workflows.note: Both reviews read the same staged diff, not each other's report. With nothing staged, the reviewers stop.

workflows.title: Write from evidence
workflows.note: Keep the citations from the first step through the final edit.
